name: User Discovery And Export Via Get-ADUser Cmdlet
description: Detects usage of the Get-ADUser cmdlet to collect user information and output it to a file
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate admin scripts may use the same technique, it's better to exclude specific computers or users who execute these commands or scripts often
query: ((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(PowerShell.EXE OR pwsh.dll))) AND ((process.command_line:*Get\-ADUser\ * AND process.command_line:*\ \-Filter\ \**) AND (process.command_line:(*\ \>\ * OR *\ \|\ Select\ * OR *Out\-File* OR *Set\-Content* OR *Add\-Content*)))
